newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Northwest Air raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Northwest Air raised.

text.p: Gruntal & Co said it upgraded Northwest Airlines Corp to buy from hold.
-- said "the stock is cheap on estimated full diluted earnings per share."
-- said a strong market, growing world economy and improvements in the Japanese economy bode well for 1998.
-- despite the upgrade, Gruntal said it cut its full-year 1997 earnings estimate to $4.90 a share from $5.50 a share and the 1998 estimate to $6.00 a share from $6.50 a share.
-- On Tuesday, Northwest posted second quarter earnings of $1.15 per diluted share, down from $1.72 per diluted share a year ago.
